applicationProcess.process_md: **Step 1:** The applicant’s parent or guardian must visit the nearest Anganwadi Centre (AWC). **Step 2:** The Anganwadi Worker (AWW) will verify the child’s age and nutritional status. **Step 3:** On confirmation of SUW or MAM status, the child will be enrolled under MSPY for a duration of 75 days. **Step 4:** Distribution of Nutrition Support: - The 75-day nutrition support after enrolment. - Hot Cooked Meals under SNP, - Besan Atta Premix (monthly), - Eggs and Bananas (weekly). **Step 5:** Anganwadi Workers conduct regular home visits, provide counselling, and monitor progress at the Anganwadi Centre.

basicDetails.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Sampoorna Pushti Yojana: Nutrition for Severely Underweight and Moderately Acute Malnourished Children (3 years - 6 years)

children.text: The beneficiary must be a resident of Odisha.
The beneficiary must be a child aged between 3 years and 6 years.
The child must be identified as Severely Underweight (SUW) or Moderately Acute Malnourished (MAM) by the Anganwadi Worker or ICDS functionary.

eligibilityCriteria.eligibilityDescription_md: 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Odisha. 1. The beneficiary must be a child aged between 3 years and 6 years. 1. The child must be identified as Severely Underweight (SUW) or Moderately Acute Malnourished (MAM) by the Anganwadi Worker or ICDS functionary.

children.text: The monthly entitlements for SUW children in the 3 years to 6 years & MAM children in the 6 months to 5 years category for a period of 75 days will be as follows:
Hot Cooked Meals under regular SNP

Hot cooked meals under regular SNP at Anganwadi Centres (AWCs), Besan Atta Premix to be delivered to the beneficiaries at the Anganwadi Centre (AWC) on the 1st of every month, Eggs and Banana to be given weekly by the Anganwadi Workers (AWW).
After 75 days, if the child graduates to normal category, the child would will be continue getting Hot Cooked Meals as children under normal category under SNP programme.

Regular growth monitoring and medical examination of all SUW & MAM children will be undertaken monthly during the VHSND by Auxiliary Nurse Midwife (ANM) and on the event of any medical complications child needs to be referred to the Community Health Centre (CHC).

If the child has not graduated to normal category or cured even after 75 days of enrolment, the child may be referred to the nearest Community Health Centre and based on the suggestion from the doctor, the child can be again enrolled under MSPY for one more cycle only.
